numeric_quality_threshold_reason: No universal therapeutic quality threshold is justified; keep rubric dimensions and scientific activation gates separate.

hypothesis_binding.fingerprint_rule: Use the runtime Hypothesis.key contract exactly; never use case_id alone or derive identity from display symbols.

reference_question.rule: Freeze questions before inspecting new arm outputs. External context must never be presented as evidence available to an arm.

source_reference.locator_note: Parquet requires row_group and row_in_group; article-level assertions require passage/table/figure and stable article version where available. Nonapplicable locator fields are null with reasons, not fabricated values.
source_reference.date_rule: Publication, annotation availability and retrieval are separate; retrieval does not prove historical availability.

assessment.rating_rule: No arithmetic mean or conversion of these categories to therapeutic probabilities. Every uncertain/not-applicable/unverifiable rating requires a reason.

dossier_assessment.coverage_denominator_rule: Count frozen questions and eligible source-world opportunities, report unanswerable questions separately; do not infer absence from uncollected inputs.

reviewer.rule: Separate executions establish procedural separation only. Missing platform model details stay null; record shared model/provider training as a dependence limitation.

adjudication.rule: Retain both initial assessments unchanged. Consensus and majority vote cannot replace source evidence.

blind_output.rule: The custodian map is evaluator-only and unavailable to initial reviewers. Scientifically necessary action/modality/context is retained. Disclose imperfect blinding and prior exposure.

legacy_crosswalk.rule: Exact match permits traceable reuse as exposed development feedback only; it does not erase original unblinded provenance or create a blind independent judgment.

cross_record_invariants: All IDs are unique within their record kind and all references resolve.
Every answer-bearing artifact and descendant retains evaluation_only lineage; none is in an agent-visible manifest.
Hypothesis fingerprints include both namespace versions, action, modality and tissue under the existing runtime contract.
Statement hashes are over exact original claim bytes; output and source hashes resolve to retained artifacts.
Each required review unit has two sealed separately executed initial assessments and evidenced adjudication or explicit unresolved status.
Initial reviewers cannot see each other's answers, adjudication, arm map or evaluator-only reference answers.
All material and critical disagreements are resolved with evidence or reported unresolved, never silently dropped.
Original-study/cohort dependency is not multiplied by integrated provider representations.
Unknown dates, biology, model identity and context are null with reasons rather than inferred.
Reviewer-consensus metrics are labeled agreement with an agent-derived development reference, not independent scientific accuracy.
Changes after inspected outputs are versioned as exploratory amendments and cannot be backdated as preregistered.
implementation_status: Field contract only; validators, concrete references and assessments must supply their own retained validation evidence.
